firstNamespaces_one: The traffic graph covers {{count}} namespace at once: it shows the first one chosen.
firstNamespaces_other: The traffic graph covers at most {{count}} namespaces at once: it shows the first ones chosen.
about: Calls between workloads with an end in these namespaces, from the request metrics in Prometheus. A line is as thick as its rate and coloured by its error rate.

peer.cannotOpen: The source does not say who this is: a caller or callee outside the mesh or the cluster, or one its labels do not name.
peer.noNamespace: The source names {{name}} without a namespace, so there is nothing to open.

notFound.workload: No Deployment, StatefulSet or DaemonSet named {{name}} in {{namespace}}.

list.caption_one: {{count}} call between two ends, busiest first
list.caption_other: {{count}} calls between two ends, busiest first

truncated_one: Showing the {{shown}} busiest of {{count}} call between two ends.
truncated_other: Showing the {{shown}} busiest of {{count}} calls between two ends.
failed: Could not read the traffic metrics of {{sources}}.
tooLong: The query for {{sources}} was too long for a proxy in front of Prometheus. Raise the proxy's URL limit, or set Prometheus by its URL in the cluster settings: long queries are then sent as a POST.
partial: Some details of the calls from {{sources}} could not be read ({{details}}): Prometheus did not answer those queries.
noPrometheus: The traffic graph is read from Prometheus, and none is set up or found for this cluster.
noSource: Prometheus has no metrics that name both ends of a call: none of Istio, Linkerd, Grafana Beyla's service graph or Cilium Hubble is reporting to it.
requestOnly: Requests per workload, without who sent them, come from {{sources}}: see the Requests section of each workload.
wouldProvide: Any of these would provide the graph: an Istio mesh, a Linkerd mesh with linkerd-viz (or a Prometheus that scrapes its proxies), Grafana Beyla with its service graph metrics enabled, or Cilium Hubble with HTTP metrics whose labelsContext names the source and destination workloads.

noEdges.minutes5: {{sources}} saw no calls with an end in these namespaces in the last 5 minutes.
noEdges.hour1: {{sources}} saw no calls with an end in these namespaces in the last hour.
